caption: The drawing depicts a metallic, round container with a slightly convex surface and a small handle or ring at the top. The container rests on two short, angled legs at its base. Emanating from the central front area of the container is a short, curved hose or tube that connects to a vertical, elongated handle or stem. At the top of the handle is a ribbed, bulbous structure that resembles a coiled or layered cover, possibly made of glass or another translucent material, held by a metallic mount. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of gray with some ochre and brownish tints, conveying a metallic and utilitarian appearance, and is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Combination Wall and Standing Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
